title: Gorp Gate Record
description: Deterministic validation gate for one run. Implemented since Wave B: `gorp run` writes this record once (scope-gate checks, artifactHash = sandbox HEAD commit, review.status 'pending') and it is never edited afterwards (append-only, hashed into the audit chain). Since Wave D the terminal human review decision is a SEPARATE immutable record (review-decision.schema.json); the embedded `review` object here is written as 'pending' and stays 'pending' in current runtime output — it is retained for record-shape compatibility.

artifactHash.description: Hash of the validated artifact/patch. Binds validation to an exact artifact.

reviewedArtifactHash.description: Unused by the current runtime: approvals are recorded in review-decision.schema.json, whose reviewedArtifactHash must (and is enforced to) match validation.artifactHash.
